name: design-exploration
summary: Create a bounded redesign or prototype artifact with current-system evidence and explicit approval before implementation.
inputs: client/project, target surface, audience, primary task, and business goal
approved content, Brand, Voice, Design Tokens, Stack, and current rendered/source evidence when applicable
writes: approved design specification, acceptance matrix, or disposable prototype evidence
approval_gates: external reads and vault writes follow harness/policies/approvals.md
done_when: authority, current-system facts, observations, proposals, and gaps separated
specification/prototype records responsive, accessibility, and interaction acceptance
parent records approval or awaiting-approval state
verification: changed Markdown/frontmatter/links or disposable artifact verified
mode, target, authority, current-system evidence, destination, and approval boundary explicit
actual target and current rendered/source behavior inspected
mode-appropriate artifact, responsive/accessibility requirements, gaps, and non-goals recorded

stages.condition: use web-quality-verification only when a rendered prototype is explicitly in scope
verification: evidence sufficiency, scope, accessibility/mobile implications, and approval state independently checked
approval recorded or work remains awaiting-approval; no unapproved implementation proceeds
